# Shipping notes

Orders ship in **two** to _three_ days, with ~~free~~ `flat-rate` postage. E = mc<sup>2</sup>, H<sub>2</sub>O.

## Steps

1. Pack
2. Label [guide](https://shop.test/labels "Label guide")
3. Ship

- [x] Weighed
- [ ] Insured
